positions.name: AnalyticsDatabaseMigrationRationale
positions.frame: what criteria, performance targets, and schedule govern the analytics pipeline migration from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB?
positions.why: The segments collectively frame an architectural decision to migrate the analytics data store, setting out the rationale (10x query performance, licensing cost reduction), technical path (PostgreSQL to QuantumDB), and delivery target (Q3 2026).
